what: full official-val reproduction of GLOD-RIS with the now-working GLM access (2026-10-10 operator instruction, second attempt)
implementation: independent reimplementation at /home/msj_team/Jacob/sys/glod_ris_repro (author repo unavailable); production-grade GLM layer added: tolerant grid parsing (quoted digits, floats, category->cells dicts, nested rows, 1-based cell-index lists, all-zero grids accepted), a repair prompt stating the parse error, 8192-token escalation on finish_reason=length, 429/5xx retried with backoff, parked failures that never abort the run and are retried at the end. Pipeline hardening (found by the full-val run itself): all-zero grids use a uniform localization map; parked guidance routes the selector to a DOD-only configuration (no category/localization terms); guidance without a usable category drops only the category term
cache: glod/../cache: existing vision cache reused where valid (keyed by image sha + settings, unaffected by the code fix); GLM responses cached per (image, expression, model, grid); 704MB vision + GLM cache carried over from the aborted first attempt (which stopped at 223/10,834); the aborted run's per-expression records were NOT reused because the implementation hash changed (new output dirs full_<tag>_v2)
protocol: official val splits; mIoU = mean per-expression IoU; oIoU = cumulative intersection/union -- the protocol the published numbers use

glm_failures.note: parked = GLM guidance unavailable after repair retries; those expressions ran the DOD-only path and are flagged in their records (guidance_source=GLM-parked-DOD-only)

fallbacks.note: all-zero grid = GLM answered no occupied cell; the pipeline uses a uniform (uninformative) localization map and flags localization_skipped in the record. category_missing = a guidance answer without a usable category; only the category term is dropped for that expression.
